name: By the End of the Night
source:
They say that if you stay together in the Villa von Radetz until the sun rises, Lady Giuditta will grant your wish. Fewer say that if you’re lucky, you can even see her spirit roaming the halls.

Young couple Federico and Anna meet an old friend of Federico’s at the villa-turned-museum. Each has their own wish and their own expectations of how the night will go.

Maybe disaster was inevitable with an odd number of people.

[From [url=https://joelurker.itch.io/by-the-end-of-the-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们说，如果你们一起在冯·拉德兹别墅待到太阳升起，朱迪塔夫人就会实现你的愿望。很少有人说，如果你幸运的话，你甚至可以看到她的灵魂在大厅里徘徊。

年轻夫妇费德里科和安娜在别墅改建的博物馆里遇见了费德里科的一位老朋友。每个人都有自己的愿望和对夜晚如何度过的期望。

也许对于奇数的人来说，灾难是不可避免的。

[来自[url=https://joelurker.itch.io/by-the-end-of-the-night]Itch.io[/url]]
